meta.title: First Kernstown / Winchester — March 23, 1862
sources: Hotchkiss Battle of Kernstown 23 March 1862 (LOC g3884w.cwh00090 / H90)
American Battlefield Trust First Kernstown map (Sep 2024 PDF)
USGS 3DEP DEM — creeks snapped to local drainage minima
D8 flow accumulation used as drainage guidance
meta.notes: Polylines densified + Chaikin-smoothed; creeks snapped to DEM valleys. Roads meander (Pike lightly). Places verified against DEM peaks and ABT/Hotchkiss relative positions.

user_spec.sandy_ridge: NE-SW, west of Pike, ~28 hex × 3–5, low rounded, crest ~40 ft above Pritchard
user_spec.stone_wall: E-W across crest ~7 hex, Confederate forward line
user_spec.pritchards_hill: open plateau 3–4 hex near Pike, N/NE of ridge, ~7 hex from wall
user_spec.season: March 23, leafless, faint meadow green only

meta.geography_notes: Opequon Creek: real course passes east of the battlefield / near Kernstown east-south side; nearest approach to Winchester is ~6–8 hex east, NOT 35 hex due south. Spec distance not applied. DEM Sandy Ridge vs Pritchard relief ~48 ft (spec ~40 ft) — keep real shape, gentle render vex.

valley_pike.notes: Northern section snapped to Loudoun St through Winchester; Kernstown segment preserved.

hoge_run.notes: flow-spline corridor + DEM snap + modest meanders; clear of crest

town_run.notes: gentle meander east of Loudoun; rebuilt smooth for SE Winchester

pritchard_sandy_meadow.notes: Marshy wet meadow between Sandy Ridge and Pritchard's Hill
